title: Gemini CLI: Google's NEW Fully Free Opensource Coding Agent! Beats Claude Code!
summary: Launch promo for Gemini CLI: free tier, install walkthrough, quick demos.

assertions.quote: you get a,000 requests a day with 60 requests an hour for free using the Gemini 2.5 Pro

verdicts.note: At launch the free quota was unusually generous; Google later tightened limits and model routing, and 'capable' trailed Claude Code and Codex on many tasks.

assertions.quote: it also offers superior code structure and engineering capabilities

verdicts.note: Claude Code is widely regarded as strong on autonomous multi-step tasks, but 'best' varies by task and model release; Codex and others compete.
